README.txt.author: System
README.txt.content:
LEVEL 2: THE DUBEY CANTEEN FILES

You are now investigating a legend of IIT Ropar. Dubey Canteen is no longer treated as a physical location by official systems, yet student behavior patterns suggest it still functions as a recurring cultural node.

Multiple departments deny its existence, but independent logs, festival sightings, and NPC testimonies contradict each other.

Objective: Find the reason why Dubey Canteen doesn't exist physically.
Answer passcode clue: submit <passcode> to solve the level.
Useful Commands:
- ls
- ls -a
- cd
- cat
- pwd
- grep

Tip: Not everything important is visible.

inventory 2017.txt.author: Dubey Ji
inventory 2017.txt.content: Menu baseline established: Tea, Maggi, Samosa, Bread Pakora. Students prefer late-night orders over daytime usage. Revenue stable but behavior patterns unusual. Some students do not leave seating area even after closing hours.

inventory 2018.txt.author: Dubey Ji
inventory 2018.txt.content: Maggi demand has doubled during exam cycles. A recurring group of students refers to this place as 'best hangout spot'. No objections, as long as order is maintained.

closure notice.txt.author: Admin
closure notice.txt.content: Official closure issued due to infrastructure redevelopment. All references to private vendor operations must be archived and removed from active campus directories.

post closure scan.log.author: Campus Audit
post closure scan.log.content: Physical scan shows partial removal of structure. However, thermal readings indicate intermittent heat signatures at original canteen coordinates during late-night hours. No authorized activity recorded.

carving on bench.txt.author: Batch of 2021
carving on bench.txt.content: We sat here under the stars. The physical canteen might be gone, but as long as we remember it, the spirit of Dubey Ji lives on.

decoy graffiti.txt.author: Vandal Student
decoy graffiti.txt.content: For a good time, call the network admin! Just kidding, don't. They will blacklist you.

memory lane.txt.author: Batch of 2019
memory lane.txt.content: Dubey Canteen was not just food. It was a shared pause between chaos. Even now, alumni conversations drift back to it without intention, as if it still exists in conversation space.

the rumor.txt.author: Secret Senior
the rumor.txt.content: Dubey Ji appears during fests like ZEITGEIST or ADVITIYA when campus density exceeds normal thresholds. He does not appear during regular weekdays. This suggests event-triggered manifestation rather than physical relocation.

dubey last seen zeitgeist.txt.author: Festival Observer
dubey last seen zeitgeist.txt.content:
Last confirmed sighting occurred at Zeitgeist Ground during Zeitgeist Festival. Dubey Ji was observed serving snacks near unofficial stalls. No vendor registration existed for him in normal campus weekdays.

After event closure, all traces of his stall disappeared.

Senior Siddharth.txt.author: Siddharth 2019
Senior Siddharth.txt.content: Listen kid, if you want to find the truth, read the hidden files in the Mess Archives. The administration didn't delete the logs.

menu comparison.txt.author: Committee Head
menu comparison.txt.content:
Mess system prioritizes nutrition compliance and schedule stability. Dubey Canteen prioritized emotional satisfaction and unscheduled accessibility.

Student feedback shows higher long-term recall value for Dubey Canteen meals.

late night pattern.log.author: Data Analyst
late night pattern.log.content: Spike detected in canteen references between 01:30–03:30 AM. Correlation increases during exam periods and campus festivals. Pattern remains consistent across 6 academic cycles.

Mess Manager Sharma.txt.author: Sharma Ji
Mess Manager Sharma.txt.content: We try to match the Bread Omelettes, but nobody can duplicate Dubey Canteen's aura. It is like his canteen is tied to the soil here.

festival 2025 overview.txt.author: Event Admin
festival 2025 overview.txt.content: Zeitgeist Festival reached peak attendance at 21:10. Multiple unofficial vendors appeared briefly without registration. Dubey Ji was reported among them but was never logged in system records.

ground anomaly scan.log.author: Security System
ground anomaly scan.log.content: Ground mapping shows temporary duplication of stall coordinates during peak crowd density. Coordinates normalize after event ends.

ground sketch.txt.author: Volunteer
ground sketch.txt.content: I sketched the ground layout during DJ night. A small tea stall appeared near the main generator. When the generator team checked, they only found a bucket of hot water and used tea leaves.

Dubey Ji Profile.txt.author: System Record
Dubey Ji Profile.txt.content:
Entity: Dubey Ji
Role: Former Campus Canteen Operator
Status: Unstable / Event-Linked Presence

Last Confirmed Physical Record: Pre-closure canteen site
Last Verified Sighting: Zeitgeist Ground during festival conditions
Behavior Pattern: Appears only during high emotional density events (festivals, large gatherings).

security guard paaji.txt.author: Security NPC
security guard paaji.txt.content: I don’t log him because he doesn’t stay long enough to be logged. One moment he’s there, next moment he’s part of the crowd like he always was.

mess worker sunita.txt.author: Mess Staff
mess worker sunita.txt.content: Students keep asking about Dubey Ji. I never met him officially...Must be a legend for old students here...

Tea Lover Amit.txt.author: Amit EE
Tea Lover Amit.txt.content:
If you are tired enough from mid-semester prep, just go to Dubey Canteen. Oh sorry, he's no more here at campus...What did you say? Yeah I'm sure I am tea lover only. Anyways, Dubey Canteen was closed due to unhygiene reports during audits and there was a non-veg and veg mixing issue and hence in absence of a valid tender, Dubey Canteen was relieved from it's operations. He however comes for a while during fests... Maybe you'll get a chance to meet him in next fest!? And also take this: UNHYGIENIC

 submit this code to go to level 3

entity merge.log.author: Backend AI
entity merge.log.content: Dubey Canteen entity merges with student memory clusters.

memory index dump.txt.author: System Core
memory index dump.txt.content: Index fragmentation detected. Multiple versions of Dubey Ji existence co-occur depending on dataset load. No single canonical record exists.
